scenarios.mech: Final guidance preserves the draft's broad development approach for locally applied steroid treatments for hemorrhoid symptoms.
Final guidance allows greater flexibility in development approaches following discussion with sponsors and the academic community.

forecasts.notes: Evidence establishes a discussion-oriented draft but little substantive detail. Guidance finalization commonly takes years; the draft's age alone provides little evidence of imminent adoption.

scenarios.mech: Require reasonable, transparent penal charges instead of penal interest for payment defaults and other material contractual breaches.
Retain the charges framework while allowing a longer transition or narrower application to accommodate lender implementation.
Allow implementation flexibility while strengthening disclosure and proportionality requirements for penal charges.

forecasts.notes: Explicit policy commitment and a completed comment window favor adoption within six months. Only five days have elapsed since comments closed, limiting immediate-action probability; implementation concerns could produce concessions.

scenarios.mech: Adopt disclosure and presentation requirements enabling borrowers to compare multiple lenders' offers through lending service providers.
Preserve transparency requirements while allowing flexibility in offer presentation, coverage, or implementation timing.
Strengthen safeguards against misleading comparisons while easing selected operational requirements for lending service providers.

forecasts.notes: An accepted recommendation, explicit policy commitment, and completed consultation support eventual adoption. More than ten months since the comment deadline allows substantial processing time but does not establish an imminent publication date.
missing: Full draft display and comparison requirements
Consultation feedback and unresolved operational issues

scenarios.mech: Finalize technical considerations for demonstrating emergency-use injector reliability in BLA, NDA, and ANDA submissions.
Retain reliability expectations while permitting more flexible testing approaches or supporting evidence appropriate to the device.
Strengthen testing or validation recommendations because delivery failures can prevent treatment of life-threatening conditions.

forecasts.notes: The explicit life-saving reliability rationale supports eventual finalization. Technical guidance commonly remains pending for years, and a nearly year-old draft provides no firm publication timetable.
